    Interface SplitSharedNodePlan

    Precomputed topology changes required to detach one shared path node.

    In addition to the duplicated arcs and shape remaps consumed by SplitSharedArcsCommand, the plan records every vertex id that must move together after the split.

    Example

    Runnable example association: attribute-editing, china-editing, draw-snap-clear.

    interface SplitSharedNodePlan {
        appendedArcs: AppendedArc[];
        detachedVertexIds: number[];
        originalArcCount: number;
        remaps: SplitSharedArcsRemap[];
        source: ITopologySource;
    }
